patterns_discovered.description: Dedicated memory engines emerging as critical infrastructure for multi-agent systems
evidence: GibsonAI/Memori - Open-source memory engine for LLMs and multi-agent systems
Explicitly designed for persistent agent memory
implications: Agents need to learn from past experiences
patterns_discovered.chained_application: Implement persistent memory layer for Chained's 48 agents

patterns_discovered.description: Tech giants releasing production-grade agent development and testing toolkits
evidence: google/adk-go - Code-first Go toolkit for sophisticated AI agents
implications: Systematic testing required for production agents
Evaluation separates toy projects from production systems

chained_specific_recommendations.rationale: GibsonAI/Memori proves multi-agent systems need persistent memory. Chained's 48 agents currently have no cross-session learning.
success_metrics: Agents can store experiences after completing work
Agents can recall similar past experiences

chained_specific_recommendations.rationale: Google's ADK-Go demonstrates production agents need systematic testing. Current agent improvements are trial-and-error.
success_metrics: Test scenarios exist for all 48 agents

chained_specific_recommendations.rationale: Claude structured outputs show schema-driven communication enables reliability. Current agent outputs are free-form.
success_metrics: JSON schemas for all agent message types

chained_specific_recommendations.rationale: GPT-5.1's conversational focus highlights importance of interaction history. Agents don't remember user preferences.

implementation_risks.mitigation: Start with simple JSON storage, iterate to database if needed

Implement schemas gradually, maintain backward compatibility
